result.rationale: In zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts, the diff passes `credentialId` as the third argument to refreshOAuthTokens while every other integration (google, hubspot, lark, office365, webex, zoom, zohocrm) passes `credential.userId`. refreshOAuthTokens sends this value as `calcomUserId` to the sync endpoint, so passing the credential id mis-keys the sync lookup.
